label: early original-phase u (and w/o at position 3)
explanation: Fires almost only in the original (input) phase, at positions 2-5, and peaks at position 3 (59% of activation mass). It never fires at t=0-1 or in the copy phase. The input token matters most: u has 18x lift and carries 67% of the mass, w has 6.8x and o 3.8x, and d and v contribute weakly. The strongest activations are u at position 3, which reaches the max, and often follow a first token of j or b. Position modulates magnitude: u at t=5 or later is mostly silent. First occurrences of a token fire more often (in_first lift 1.7x). Precision is limited because many u/w/o inputs at the right positions stay inactive, and the predicate does not capture which preceding tokens gate them.
